newyear.name: New Year statues
newyear.description: Dance into the New Year with the lights: party while the matrix is green, freeze when it turns red. The body sensor or each player's phone sees who moves
newyear.intro: Musical statues for New Year: everyone dances while the matrix is green ("Party!") and freezes when it turns red ("Freeze!"). Whoever moves during the red light is out; the last one standing wins. The body sensor or each player's phone sees who moves. Pick the matrix, then Save.
